node.title: get specific value of element using xpath in perl
node.author: snehit.ar
node.doctext: Apollo 13 Ron Howard 1995-06-30 Solaris Steven Soderbergh 2002-11-27 Ender's Game Gavin Hood 2013-11-01 I want to retrieve value of element where having value 'Solaris' and not other title elements. <code> use warnings; use strict; use XML::XPath; use Data::Dumper; my $xml = '../events.xml'; my $xp = XML::XPath->new(filename => $xml); my $nodeset = $xp->findnodes('//playlist'); my $records = []; foreach my $node ($nodeset->get_nodelist) { my $title = $xp->find('./title', $node); push @$records, { title => $title->string_value, }; } print Dumper($records); </code> I tired XPath something like <code> my $title= $xp->find("/playlist/movie[title='Solaris']/release-date", $node); </code> But result is not as expected OutPut ::2002-11-27 Please do help !
